clusters.headline: Authorities Investigate Alleged Wiretapping Of President Prabowo
aiSummaryBullets: The Witness and Victim Protection Agency is reviewing protection requests from six witnesses reporting intimidation.
The National Police have initiated internal ethical hearings for senior officials, including an Inspector General, regarding the incident.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Pursue Opinion Rights Over Vice President Issue
aiSummaryBullets: Fifty members of the Indonesian House of Representatives have signed a petition to invoke their right to express an official opinion.
The legislative initiative focuses on ongoing controversies surrounding the educational credentials of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Parliamentary Leaders Address Calls To Impeach Gibran
aiSummaryBullets: Speaker of the House Puan Maharani affirmed that Gibran Rakabuming Raka maintains his position as Vice President of Indonesia.
Protests occurred in Surabaya and at the House of Representatives demanding the removal of the Vice President from office.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Recognizes Leaders In The Pilah Olah Sampah Heroes 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta administration honored citizens and influencers for their contributions to waste management at the Pilah Olah Sampah Heroes 2026 ceremony.
Award recipients included community leaders and content creators who implemented innovative waste reduction and organic processing initiatives.

clusters.headline: Three Prominent PSI Leaders Resign To Focus On Government Roles
aiSummaryBullets: High-ranking members Giring Ganesha, Raja Juli Antoni, and Isyana Bagoes Oka have formally stepped down from the Indonesian Solidarity Party.
The officials cited the need to dedicate their full attention to their respective responsibilities within the government.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Confers National Hero Titles To Several Figures
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is presiding over an official ceremony at the State Palace to confer the status of National Hero on several figures.
The list of honorees includes various historical and community leaders such as KH Abbas Abdul Jamil, Ali Sadikin, Hoegeng, and Jenderal M Jusuf.

clusters.headline: Calls For Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka To Resign Intensify
aiSummaryBullets: Members of the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) publicly urged Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka to resign from his position.
Lawmaker Yanuar Arif Wibowo displayed a poster reading 'Mas Gibran Mundur atau Dimundurkan' following a plenary session at the DPR.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Attorney General Office Names PT BSJ As Nickel Case Suspect
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office designated PT Bumi Sentosa Jaya as a corporate suspect in a nickel corruption case in Southeast Sulawesi.
Investigators identified Arif Kurniawan, the beneficial owner of the mining company, as a central figure in the ongoing probe.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Ministers Highlight Education Goals And National Unity
aiSummaryBullets: Coordinating Minister for Politics and Security Dudung Abdurachman urged citizens to uphold national unity in honor of Hero's Day.
Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture Sugiono distributed stationery to over 700 elementary schools in Tangerang.

clusters.headline: Speaker Of The House Puan Maharani Denies Receiving TNI Chief Letter
aiSummaryBullets: House Speaker Puan Maharani stated that the DPR has not received a presidential letter regarding a change in TNI leadership.
The remarks serve as a direct response to circulating rumors on social media about the potential replacement of General Agus Subiyanto.
